text: DRUG INTERACTIONS ANTIPSYCHOTIC DRUGS SUCH AS PHENOTHIAZINES OR HALOPERIDOL; TRICYCLIC ANTIDEPRESSANTS (SEE WARNINGS ). CONTRAINDICATIONS HYPERSENSITIVITY TO BENZTROPINE MESYLATE TABLETS OR TO ANY COMPONENT OF THE TABLETS. BECAUSE OF ITS ATROPINE-LIKE SIDE EFFECTS, THIS DRUG IS CONTRAINDICATED IN PEDIATRIC PATIENTS UNDER THREE YEARS OF AGE, AND SHOULD BE USED WITH CAUTION IN OLDER PEDIATRIC PATIENTS.
